summary: Chooses the layout an element takes part in and the one it gives its children.
details: The outer type (block, inline) decides how the element sits among its siblings; the inner type (flow, flex, grid) decides how its children are laid out. display: flex is block outside, flex inside.

values.note: Full-width box on its own line.
Flows with text; width and height are ignored.
Flows with text but respects width and height.
Children become flex items on one axis.
Children are placed on a two-dimensional grid.

gotcha: Flex and grid properties (gap, justify-content…) do nothing until the parent has display: flex or grid.
